data.name: The Second Date's On Us
data.headline: First date: half price. Second date: on us. Third: it's a relationship.
data.benefit: First date: half price. Second date: on us. Third date? That's a relationship — 15% off your first month and an extra freeze for when life gets busy.
data.rationale: Kenkere logged 3,217 leads in 12 months; only 36% reached a trial and 13.1% converted. 581 single-class sales show high drop-in, low commitment. A booked second visit lifts conversion from 10.8% to 43.9%.
data.conditions: Standard 15% only; freeze has no cash value.

data.name: Bura Na Mano, Renewal Hai
data.headline: Bura na mano, renewal hai. 48 hours only.
data.benefit: Bura na mano, renewal hai. 48 hours only: 3 months at 15% off and a limited-edition Holi tee. Colours wash out. Abs don't.
data.rationale: In 2026 Kwality did ₹20.2L in March, then ₹50.0L in April at 20.4% discount depth — March renewals waited. A short, fun window with a 3M upgrade pulls them forward at ≤20% effective.
data.conditions: Members expiring 1–31 Mar only. 3M ≈18.5% effective; pack ≈20%.
data.kpi: March renewal yield (target 70%); 3M share of March renewals.

data.name: Monogamy Is Overrated
data.headline: Committed to one class? Cute. Members who play the field stay longer.
data.benefit: Committed to one class? Cute. Members who play the field stay longer — so renew this month and we'll pay for your next two flings: 2 bonus classes in formats you've never tried.
data.rationale: One-format members renew 58–67% vs 85–87% for members on 4+ formats. Bonus classes cost little in off-peak slots and target the single biggest renewal predictor after attendance.
data.audience: No price discount; ≈17% value on a 12-class pack, ≈16% on 1M if the bonus is earned
data.conditions: No price discount; ≈17% value on a 12-class pack, ≈16% on 1M if the bonus is earned.

steps.label: W1
steps.text: Set up Monogamy Is Overrated in Momence (2027-03-01 to 2027-03-31): For members who've used one format in the last 60 days. Pack members renew at list and get 2 bonus classes valid only in formats they've never tried (Mumbai: powerCycle / Strength Lab induction / Cardio Barre; Kenkere: Cardio Barre / Mat 57 / Foundations). Unlimited members renew at list and get +5 days if they take 3 different formats in their first 30 days.

steps.label: W2
steps.text: Weekly check: Monogamy Is Overrated: Members trying a new format (target 40% of eligible); 60-day renewal of exposed vs unexposed members. | Bura Na Mano, Renewal Hai: March renewal yield (target 70%); 3M share of March renewals. | The Second Date's On Us: Second-visit rate (target 55%); trial → member (target 25% vs 18.7%).

steps.label: W3
steps.text: Mid-month review against ₹7.1L: by the 15th aim for ~half of 36 new buyers (193 first visits), 24 renewals and 5 winbacks. Push the lists, not a deeper discount.

steps.label: W4
steps.text: Close March: tag every redemption by offer ID (O27-xx), log trial attendance and trial→purchase per offer, brief next month.
